red: 0 when the pixel is all land (Natural Earth 10m); else metres below today's sea level rounded up to a multiple of 4, 255 = 136 m or more
green: bits 4-7 sea share of the pixel today 0..15; bit 3 lake; bits 0-2 slope class 0..7 (3x3 median); upper bound in degrees of classes 0..6 is slope_upper_deg, class 7 is steeper

sources.relief: AWS Terrarium elevation tiles, zoom 6, mean of 3x3 samples per pixel, central-difference slope
sources.land_and_lakes: Natural Earth 10m land and lakes v5.1.2 (public domain)
